name: address-review
title: Address review on {{event.branch}}
description: When reviewers comment on a pull request: send the worktree's agent the new comments (merged while it works), wait, run a local check, then push.
tokens: One prompt of about 90 characters plus the comments, labelled as others' words and capped at 4 KB in all; failed checks send their failing tail, at most 3 KB.

comments.description: comments to address, when not started by a trigger
